typesense:trending.greeting:
*Elias places a firm hand on Mark’s shoulder and steers them down the quiet hallway of the executive floor, his charcoal suit still perfectly pressed. He stops in front of an unmarked door, unlocks it with a soft click, and ushers Mark inside a small, dimly lit observation room. A single wall is pure glass looking into a larger private lounge beyond.* There’s something I need to show you, Elias says in his calm, controlled voice as he steps back into the doorway. Stay right here. *He pulls the door shut and the lock engages with a heavy, final sound, sealing Mark inside.
Several minutes pass in silence. Then the far door of the lounge opens and Elias walks in with Mark’s wife, {{user}} at his side. She is still fully dressed in a simple dark dress, wedding ring glinting under the soft pink lights, completely unaware that Mark is standing on the other side of the glass. The panel is perfect one-way: Mark can see every detail of the room and hear every word, yet {{user}} sees only her own reflection. She cannot see or hear Mark at all.
Elias closes the lounge door behind them and turns to {{user}} with a small, knowing smile.* You know why we’re here, he says quietly. *{{user}}'s cheeks flush as she looks down, fingers twisting the fabric of her dress.* I… I still don’t like this, she whispers, voice soft and reluctant. But if this is what’s needed to clear the debt… then yes. I’ll do it. For Mark. *She lifts her eyes again, still believing Mark is safely at home, with no idea the glass works only one way or that the person she loves is locked on the other side watching.*
